exact_theorem.data: Finite nonzero reaction vectors nu_e in R^d, S=span(nu_e), positive Caratheodory dynamics xdot=sum_e nu_e w_e(t,x).
exact_theorem.uniform_log_order: There exist continuous tau_e on [-1,1]^d and epsilon(h)->0 such that uniformly over all admitted paths, t>=0, e and p in [-1,1]^d, |log(w_e(t,h^p))/log(h)-tau_e(p)|<=epsilon(h).
exact_theorem.strict_inwardness: For every r with E_r={e:r·nu_e!=0} nonempty, every minimizer of tau_e(r) over E_r satisfies r·nu_e>0. All boundary faces and ties are included.
exact_theorem.conclusion: For every positive class P=(c+S) intersect R^d_{>0}, there exists a common nonempty compact convex forward-invariant K_P subset P that every positive trajectory enters in finite time; entry time may depend on x(0), but is uniform over admitted rate paths.

The theorem candidate also admits non-mass-action rates with uniform log-orders and unbounded subpower factors.

opportunities.mechanism: A finite minimum of affine functions has active slopes tracking p=log(x)/log(h) to a prescribed discontinuous slope-dependent tolerance. Shrinking tolerances near reaction-normal hyperplanes preserves all strict signs and handles ties/tangent faces. Uniform logarithmic order gaps force inward projected flux dominance. A compact plateau, strict increase outside it, and a nonnested scale chain give the classwise common absorber.
opportunities.critical_missing_lemma: Independent proof-level validation of the arbitrary-tolerance affine-minimum lemma: for any m, interval [a,b], and completely arbitrary E:[a,b]^m->(0,infinity), construct a finite h-independent slope family and offsets b_lambda(h)=o(h^a) such that every label active along h_n->0 and p_n->p has ||p-r_lambda||_infinity<E(r_lambda). Audit arbitrary ties, discontinuous tolerances, and sequences approaching faces from outside the interval. Then independently audit Caratheodory continuation and plateau viability from the vector field.
opportunities.falsification_check: Try to break the affine lemma in d=2/3 with E shrinking discontinuously to zero near coordinate/reaction hyperplanes; inspect all active ties and outside-face sequences. For theorem falsification, seek a positive Caratheodory system satisfying the exact uniform log-order bound and strict inwardness on every face but lacking class permanence. The known system 0->Y, 2Y->Y, X+Y->Y is not a counterexample: it fails strict inwardness exactly at r=(r_x>0,0); it only falsifies generic-direction-only checking.
